CustomField.description: The legal entity that signs, where a borrower borrows through a subsidiary. Access still hangs off Borrower_Account__c: a sharing set matches a Contact to one Account and does not walk a hierarchy, so child Accounts would hide loans from their signers.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Borrowing entity, where the borrower borrows through a subsidiary or holding company. Leave empty when the parent borrows directly.
